_about: RH20T per-leaf licence split, read from meta/episodes_source.jsonl (source_scene) and the episode lengths of every converted RH20T leaf (tools/trim_noncommercial.py --scan-rh20t <camx_480p root>, 2026-10-30). RH20T-C = scenes 0001-0005 (CC BY-SA 4.0) is the only part the site may carry; RH20T-NC = scenes 0006-0010 (CC BY-NC 4.0, no commercial use); scenes above 0010 belong to neither subset and are left out as well. licensed_episodes are loader indices (episode_idx); scenes maps every episode index to its source scene.
